title: Sustainable adaptation in agriculture: exploring consumer support for low-carbon climate resilient crops
title_zh: 农业可持续适应：消费者对低碳气候韧性作物的支持研究
authors: Peter Tait, John Saunders, Jane Mullaney, Matthew Roskruge, Paul Rutherford
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Agricultural production systems around the globe are experiencing significant climate-driven pressures. As climate change effects intensify, agricultural adaptation must align with climate sustainability policy and consumers who are attentive to production that reduce supply-chain emissions. This study provides case-study evidence from New Zealand, where warming climatic conditions are driving exploration of alternative horticultural land uses such as bananas, and where consumer demand may influence whether such diversification pathways are commercially viable. We examine how preferences for cleaner production attributes shape banana demand using a discrete choice experiment of banana consumers designed to assess the effects of organic and spray-free production, carbon-zero claims, and local origin on consumer choices. A Latent Class Analysis identified preference heterogeneity finding 38% of consumers state willingness to pay for low environmental impact attributes: organic (+76%), spray-free (+33%) and carbon-zero (+23%), indicating potential demand for environmentally produced bananas aligned with a changing climate. The findings suggest that a differentiated domestic banana product could support sustainable production and climate-adaptive diversification but should be interpreted as case study stated-preference demand-side evidence rather than as an assessment of industry feasibility. Further evidence on production costs, supply-chain logistics, and revealed demand is needed before drawing stronger conclusions about commercial potential.
abstract_zh: 全球农业生产系统正面临显著的气候变化压力。随着气候变化影响加剧，农业适应措施必须与气候可持续政策及关注供应链减排的消费者需求相协调。本研究以新西兰为案例，该国气候变暖正推动香蕉等替代性园艺土地利用方式的探索，而消费者需求可能影响此类多元化路径的商业可行性。我们通过香蕉消费者离散选择实验，考察清洁生产属性偏好如何塑造香蕉需求，旨在评估有机生产、无农药生产、碳中和声明及本地来源对消费者选择的影响。潜在类别分析揭示了偏好异质性，发现38%的消费者愿意为低环境影响的属性支付溢价：有机（+76%）、无农药（+33%）和碳中和（+23%），这表明对适应气候变化的环境友好型香蕉存在潜在需求。研究结果表明，差异化本土香蕉产品可支持可持续生产与气候适应性多元化，但应将其解读为案例研究中的陈述偏好需求侧证据，而非行业可行性评估。在得出关于商业潜力的更可靠结论前，仍需进一步获取生产成本、供应链物流及显示性需求方面的证据。

title:
Fragmentation and the Future of
                    GVCs
title_zh: 碎片化与全球价值链的未来
authors: Francesco Paolo Conteduca, Michele Mancini, Giacomo Romanini, Simona Giglioli, Alessandro Borin 等
abstract: In the current confrontational geopolitical climate, countries have intensified the use of selective trade restrictions to exert economic coercion. This paper introduces targeted trade restrictions between a US‐centric bloc and a China‐centric bloc into a general equilibrium trade model that features nonlinear adjustments and input–output connections. We study how micro‐level restrictions—based on data identifying high‐weaponization‐potential products—affect welfare and the macroeconomic structure of global value chains (GVCs). Our findings reveal that while global economic integration is marginally affected, its topology changes: chains become more regional and rely more on non‐aligned countries acting as connectors between opposing blocs, in ways that may be hard to detect in standard trade data.
abstract_zh: 在当前对抗性地缘政治气候下，各国强化了选择性贸易限制手段以实施经济胁迫。本文将美国主导集团与中国主导集团之间的针对性贸易限制引入具有非线性调整特征和投入产出关联的一般均衡贸易模型。基于识别高武器化潜力产品的微观数据，我们研究了微观层面的限制措施如何影响福利与全球价值链的宏观经济结构。研究结果表明，尽管全球经济一体化受到轻微影响，但其拓扑结构发生了改变：价值链呈现区域化趋势，并更依赖不结盟国家作为对立集团之间的连接枢纽——这种变化在标准贸易数据中可能难以察觉。

title: New importer dynamics and the effects of trade shocks
title_zh: 新进口商动态与贸易冲击的影响
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: New importers increase their conditional survival rate and import share over time. However, a model of multi-input firms with an import entry cost and stochastic import costs cannot replicate these dynamics. I show that an extended model can be reconciled with the data. I calibrate both models and use them to identify the effects of trade shocks. The simulations show that a decrease in import prices with the new importer dynamics generates lower productivity gains, but these gains are more widespread across firms.
abstract_zh: 新进口商的存活率和进口份额随时间推移而提高。然而，一个包含进口进入成本和随机进口成本的多投入企业模型无法复现这些动态特征。本文证明，扩展后的模型能够与数据相吻合。我对两个模型进行了校准，并利用它们识别贸易冲击的影响。模拟结果表明，在新进口商动态特征下，进口价格下降带来的生产率提升幅度较小，但这些提升在企业间的分布更为广泛。

title: The Incredible Flexibility of Moment Matching
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We ask how far the choice of which moments to match can push estimates in misspecified structural models. The answer is: very far. Under regularity conditions, an adversarial researcher informed about the data distribution can choose moments that render any parameter value the unique solution to the population moment-matching problem. Moreover, in many cases they can do so with little increase in model-implied standard errors relative to maximum likelihood. We illustrate both results in a menu-cost model.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨在错误设定的结构模型中，选择匹配哪些矩条件能在多大程度上影响估计结果。答案是：影响极大。在正则条件下，一位了解数据分布信息的对抗性研究者可以选择矩条件，使得任何参数值都成为总体矩匹配问题的唯一解。此外，在许多情况下，他们这样做时，模型隐含的标准误相较于最大似然估计仅有微小增加。我们通过一个菜单成本模型对这两个结论进行了说明。

title: The association between parent–child discrepancies in educational expectations and adolescents’ cognitive ability
title_zh: 亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关联
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Educational expectations play an important role in adolescents’ cognitive development and human capital accumulation. Using four waves of the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) from 2010, 2014, 2018, and 2022, this article examines how parental educational expectations, children’s own educational expectations, and parent–child educational expectation discrepancies relate to adolescents’ cognitive ability. We find that both parental and children’s own educational expectations are positively associated with cognitive ability. However, relative to aligned expectations, discrepancies in either direction, whether parental educational expectations exceed or fall below children’s expectations, are associated with significantly lower cognitive ability among adolescents. Mechanism analyses suggest that discrepancies in either direction are associated with more frequent parent–child conflict. Upward-biased discrepancies are associated with lower adolescent academic self-efficacy, whereas downward-biased discrepancies are associated with lower parental homework involvement. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that these negative associations are stronger among students in regular class tracks, students from low-income households, students with less-educated parents, and rural students. Further analysis suggests that consistently high and aligned expectations correspond to the highest cognitive ability. These findings highlight the potential importance of expectation alignment within families and suggest that disadvantaged rural and low-income groups may warrant particular attention in educational policy design.
abstract_zh: 教育期望在青少年认知发展与人力资本积累中扮演重要角色。本文基于2010年、2014年、2018年和2022年四期中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，考察父母教育期望、子女自身教育期望及亲子教育期望差异与青少年认知能力的关系。研究发现：父母教育期望与子女自身教育期望均与认知能力呈正相关。然而，相较于期望一致的情形，无论父母期望高于还是低于子女期望，期望偏差均与青少年认知能力显著降低相关。机制分析表明，双向期望偏差均与更频繁的亲子冲突相关；向上偏差与青少年学业自我效能感降低相关，而向下偏差则与父母作业辅导参与度降低相关。异质性分析显示，上述负向关联在普通班学生、低收入家庭学生、父母受教育程度较低的学生及农村学生中更为显著。进一步分析表明，持续且一致的较高期望对应最高水平的认知能力。这些发现凸显了家庭内部期望一致性的潜在重要性，并提示教育政策设计应特别关注处于弱势地位的农村与低收入群体。

title: Initial Margin for Crypto Currencies Risks in Uncleared Markets
title_zh: 未清算市场加密货币风险的初始保证金
authors: Anna Amirdjanova, David Lynch, Anni Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-02-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine prospective classification of crypto currencies risks within the ISDA Standardized Initial Margin Model (SIMM) framework for calculation of initial margin on trades sensitive to cryptocurrencies’ risk factors in the uncleared market. Consistent with the view that cryptocurrencies are digital assets that fundamentally rely on distributed ledger technology (DLT) and induce financial risks that are significantly different from those in traditional risk classes like commodities or FX, we find that cryptocurrencies are best classified into a distinct risk class within SIMM that is split into two buckets – pegged and floating (unpegged) crypto currencies as risk factors - and suggest risk weights’ calibration methodology within the cryptocurrencies risk class that is consistent with the existing approaches adopted in SIMM.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在ISDA标准化初始保证金模型（SIMM）框架下，对未清算市场中受加密货币风险因子影响的交易进行初始保证金计算时，加密货币风险的预期分类问题。基于加密货币本质上是依赖分布式账本技术（DLT）的数字资产，且其引发的金融风险与商品或外汇等传统风险类别存在显著差异这一观点，我们发现加密货币在SIMM中最适合归入一个独立的风险类别，该类别进一步划分为两个子类——锚定型与浮动型（非锚定型）加密货币作为风险因子——并提出了加密货币风险类别内的风险权重校准方法，该方法与SIMM现有方法保持一致。

title: Black Suburbanization: Causes and Consequences of a Transformation of American Cities
title_zh: 黑人郊区化：美国城市转型的原因与后果
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Since 1970, the share of Black individuals living in suburbs of large cities has risen from 16% to 36%. We first show that Black suburbanization has led to major changes in neighborhoods, accounting for the majority of recent increases in both the average Black individual’s neighborhood quality and income segregation within the Black population. We then use an accounting exercise to show that changes in relative suburban amenities and housing prices explain a large share of Black suburbanization, while regional reallocation, changing educational attainment, and gentrification of Black city neighborhoods play only minor roles.
abstract_zh: 自1970年以来，居住在大城市郊区的黑人比例已从16%上升至36%。我们首先表明，黑人郊区化导致了社区的重大变化，这解释了近年来黑人个体平均社区质量提升以及黑人群体内部收入隔离加剧的大部分原因。随后，我们通过核算分析表明，郊区相对便利设施和房价的变化解释了黑人郊区化的很大一部分原因，而区域重新分配、教育程度变化以及黑人城市社区的绅士化仅起到次要作用。
